elements.text:
You've been talking to your crush on Snapchat and they're usually quick to respond. You see that they opened your message a couple of hours ago and did not respond. 

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I want to remove them from my phone, but realize that would be dramatic.
I block my crush on the app and will never talk to them again.
I focus on other important things to do today.
I want to send a bunch of messages to this person, but instead call my friends to hang out.
